user_directive: 那我们也应该按照同样的标准来吧

training.mode: single jointly trained policy across all four suites
training.normalization_and_vocabulary: fit training demonstrations only; new artifacts; never reuse Spatial-only statistics as four-suite fit statistics
training.selection: prespecified offline validation rule before closed-loop evaluation
training.comparison: matched four-suite data/splits/optimization budget across component variants; existing Spatial-trained checkpoints remain historical developmental evidence
training.difference_from_official: Project keeps whole-demo validation holdout; exact upstream released training manifest not independently verified. Shared benchmark does not imply identical pretraining/training data volume.

evaluation.reset: upstream sequential env.reset/set_init_state per task, ordered indices0..49, env.seed(7); freeze implementation before execution
evaluation.success: original LIBERO success predicate; no custom distance or relaxed threshold
evaluation.orientation: rotate raw RGB180 degrees to match dataset
evaluation.model_adapters: use each model trained preprocessing, action normalization and gripper mapping; record all differences including resolution; pi05 reference224, Mini128
evaluation.K_H: explicit frozen model settings; preserve H1/H5 comparison rather than forcing K1 policy to execute five outputs
evaluation.rollout_reuse: Old canonical-anchor/per-case-seed Spatial results are not transferable to upstream-reset final scores; full new final runs required
evaluation.errors: Policy task failures count. Infrastructure failures remain incomplete and must be repaired without selecting outcomes. Never publish partial as full.

development_and_confirmation.other_suites: 20 development IDs per task fixed via hash stratified across0..49;30 confirmation IDs
development_and_confirmation.confirmation_release: NOT_RELEASED; method, checkpoints, adapters, seeds and execution code must be frozen first
development_and_confirmation.additional_training_seeds: separate concrete run budget; do not conflate repeated evaluation with independent training repeats

resources.gpu_admission: finite idle checks; no periodic waiting monitor; no interference with other jobs
resources.expansion_budget: NOT_APPROVED_BY_THIS_STANDARD; measure missing download sizes and bounded-cache throughput before proposing an exact execution budget
